module.name: Monochrome
module.author: Viscousity
module.description: Streams Lossless and Hi-Res FLAC audio on-the-fly using Monochrome and Hi-Res public resolver backends. Swaps lossy YouTube streams with CD-quality 16-bit or studio master 24-bit FLAC without requiring an account.

resolver.label: Primary Resolver Endpoint
resolver.description: Public Hi-Res stream resolver (Monochrome or Lucida node).

fallbackResolver.label: Fallback Resolver Endpoint
fallbackResolver.description: Secondary resolver used when the primary is unreachable.

qualityOptions.label: Hi-Res · Up to 24-bit / 192 kHz FLAC
qualityOptions.description: Studio master audio resolution when available from upstream.
